driver_note: demo.validate.v3_critique could not run its Playwright half on this machine: chromium.launch() times out after 180s with the process at 0% CPU, and so does a bare launch with no page and no navigation, and so does an older pinned chromium build. The same wedged macOS XPC services that hang the Metal shader compiler hang the browser launch (`sysmond service not found`, `pkill: Cannot get process list`). demo/validate/artifacts/v2_filter/ is empty for the same reason. Every check below was therefore executed against the same running app through an already-open Chrome, evaluating the identical DOM assertions the script makes. The script is committed and unmodified in intent; re-run it on a healthy machine to regenerate this file with screenshots.

notes: criteria_recall 0.278 is 5/18 over the applicable subset; criteria_recall_all (5/24 = 0.208) is computed and stored in the run file but is NOT shown anywhere on this card.

The colSpan deviation from the AnswersPanel precedent is the right call and is confirmed in the browser: the detail td is 1110px wide and gives the criteria a two-column 524px grid. Put in the last cell it would have rendered in the ~40px LEAKS column.

span.crit-na and a.crit-ts are deliberately white-space: nowrap; they are short chips and clock times, and the clipping probe correctly excludes them. crit-na measures 0x0 because it is a non-replaced inline element, which is a measurement artifact and not truncation.
The frontend gate is the only one of the three gate items this file covers. The exclusion and provenance gates were verified separately against the corpus, not through the UI.
